Global Voltage, Travel-Ready Protection: ELEGRP Powers Dyson Supersonic Travel hair dryer

Nov 16, 2026, 02:22 ET

Share this article

LAS VEGAS, Nov. 16, 2026 /CNW/ -- With carry-on space at a premium, a travel hair dryer designed for different voltage systems is a must. The new Dyson Supersonic Travel hair dryer combines a compact, lightweight design with 100V–240V voltage compatibility, featuring an ALCI leakage protection solution developed by ELEGRP.

Made for Travel, Engineered for Global Voltage Compatibility

Continue Reading

The Dyson Supersonic Travel hair dryer is 32% smaller, 25% lighter, and supports automatic voltage adjustment from 100V to 240V.

Integrating UL-compliant ALCI protection and wide-range voltage compatibility into a compact plug presents a significant engineering challenge. ELEGRP developed a customized solution that brings both capabilities together, supporting global voltage compatibility while maintaining reliable electrical protection.

About ELEGRP
Founded in 2000, ELEGRP is a world-leading manufacturer of intelligent electrical and electromechanical equipment, including residual-current devices, wiring devices, smart home devices, wires and cables, domestic water pumps and more. Its products are widely used in household appliances, personal care appliances, smart bathrooms, power equipment, and building electrical systems.

For more information, please visit https://www.elegrp.com/ and follow ELEGRP on Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, and YouTube.
